description: 5-, 6- and 7-note MOS (moment-of-symmetry / well-formed) scale families and their concrete instantiations in 12, 22 and 31 EDO, plus notable non-MOS structures. Step patterns are given as EDO step counts and are the BRIGHTEST mode (the raw bright-generator stack); all rotations are listed under `modes`.

conventions.generatorRange: Open interval, as a fraction of the PERIOD. EDO n supports a family iff some integer k satisfies genLo*P < k < genHi*P, where P = n/periods steps.
conventions.contrast: L/s. Near 1 = near-equal/bland; ~1.5-3 = idiomatic scale contrast; >4 = cluster-plus-gap.
conventions.lopsided: true when L/s > 4 — the shape reads as a cluster plus a large gap rather than as a scale. Note 22edo's superpyth diatonic sits exactly at 4 and is NOT flagged.

scales.name: Pedal
scales.note: Semitone cluster + large gap. Structurally a MOS, not idiomatic as a scale.

scales.name: Pedal
scales.note: Whole-tone tetrachord + 400c gap. Lopsided but usable as a colour.

scales.name: Pentic
scales.note: The standard anhemitonic pentatonic. 5-limit.

scales.name: Antimachinoid
scales.note: Chromatic cluster + gap. Degenerate in practice.

scales.name: Malic
scales.note: Two semitone clusters a tritone apart (half-octave period).

scales.name: Triwood
scales.note: The augmented / hexatonic scale (1 3 1 3 1 3).

scales.name: Onyx
scales.note: Chromatic hexachord + gap. Degenerate in practice.

scales.name: Diatonic
scales.note: The diatonic scale. 12edo's fifth is 2c sharp of 3/2 (Pythagorean-ish).

nonMosStructures.name: Blues hexatonic
nonMosStructures.note: Minor pentatonic with the b5 passing tone.

nonMosStructures.name: Harmonic minor
nonMosStructures.note: Diatonic with one note raised; inherits diatonic's EDO coverage.

scales.name: Pedal
scales.note: Near-equipentatonic; 218c generator is 22edo's 8/7 (13c flat of just).

scales.name: Pentic
scales.note: The pentatonic proper (complement of the 709c superpyth fifth).

scales.name: Pentic
scales.note: Hard-contrast pentatonic on a 545c 11/8-ish generator.

scales.name: Antipentic
scales.note: Antipentic on 436c = 22edo's 9/7 septimal major third. Strongly septimal.

scales.name: Manual
scales.note: Manual pentatonic on a 273c (7/6-ish) generator.

scales.name: Antimachinoid
scales.note: Porcupine[6] — 164c generator ~ 10/9. Septimal.

scales.name: Malic
scales.note: Half-octave period; pajara/srutal territory.

scales.name: Citric
scales.note: Half-octave period, near-equal (4 4 3 4 4 3).

scales.name: Machinoid
scales.note: Machine[6] — near-equal, approximates 8:9:10:11:12:13. Septimal.

scales.name: Onyx
scales.note: PORCUPINE[7] — the flagship 22edo heptatonic (3 3 3 3 3 3 4). Septimal.

scales.name: Antidiatonic
scales.note: Antidiatonic (mavila-flavoured) on a very flat 655c fifth.

scales.name: Mosh
scales.note: Mosh, but 22edo's 382c generator is a 5/4, NOT a neutral third — this is not a neutral scale in 22.

scales.name: Smitonic
scales.note: Smitonic on a 327c ~6/5 generator (hanson-like).

scales.name: Diatonic
scales.note: SUPERPYTH diatonic — 709c fifth. Its diatonic major third is 8\22 = 436c = 9/7, so the major triad is a septimal SUPERMAJOR 14:18:21 and the minor triad is a SUBMINOR 6:7:9 (5\22 = 7/6). The just 5/4 (7\22) is NOT a diatonic degree — 4:5:6:7 needs a chromatic note.

nonMosStructures.name: Hexany (1·3·5·7)
nonMosStructures.note: 1/1 7/6 5/4 35/24 5/3 7/4. 35/24 and 5/4 are near-exact; 5/3 is 12c flat and 7/4 is 13c sharp.

nonMosStructures.name: Otonal 8:9:10:11:12:13:14
nonMosStructures.note: 22's 11/8 (10\22, -6c) and 5/4 (7\22, -5c) are excellent; the 9th (+14c), 13th (-22c) and 7th (+13c) are the weak links.

nonMosStructures.name: Superpyth harmonic minor
nonMosStructures.note: Aeolian (4 1 4 4 1 4 4) with the 7th raised by the chroma L-s = 3 steps.

scales.name: Pedal
scales.note: SLENDRIC[5] — 232c generator = a near-just 8/7. Slendro-like. Septimal.

scales.name: Pentic
scales.note: The meantone pentatonic (4/3 generator).

scales.name: Pentic
scales.note: Hard pentatonic on a 542c 11/8 generator. Undecimal.

scales.name: Antipentic
scales.note: Antipentic on 426c ~ 9/7. Septimal.

scales.name: Antipentic
scales.note: Antipentic on 465c ~ 21/16.

scales.name: Manual
scales.note: Manual pentatonic on a 271c ~7/6 generator. Septimal.

scales.name: Antimachinoid
scales.note: Near-equal hexatonic (five 194c steps + one 232c).

scales.name: Machinoid
scales.note: Slendric[6] — six 8/7s, one small step. Septimal.

scales.name: Onyx
scales.note: Porcupine[7] shape, but 155c is a poor porcupine generator in 31.

scales.name: Antidiatonic
scales.note: Antidiatonic on a 658c fifth — very flat mavila.

scales.name: Mosh
scales.note: MOHAJIRA[7] — 348c generator = a near-just 11/9 NEUTRAL third. The principal neutral heptatonic.

scales.name: Mosh
scales.note: Same family on a 387c 5/4 generator — lopsided, not neutral.

scales.name: Smitonic
scales.note: HANSON/KLEISMIC[7] — 310c generator ~ 6/5.

scales.name: Diatonic
scales.note: MEANTONE diatonic — 696.8c fifth is essentially exact 1/4-comma meantone.

scales.name: Archeotonic
scales.note: Near-equiheptatonic (six 194c steps + one 39c).

nonMosStructures.name: Hexany (1·3·5·7)
nonMosStructures.note: 1/1 7/6 5/4 35/24 5/3 7/4. 31edo is one of the best 7-limit EDOs — this sings.

nonMosStructures.name: Maqam Rast
nonMosStructures.note: Same step multiset as mohajira (3 large / 4 small) but arranged L s s L L s s — NOT a MOS rotation.

nonMosStructures.name: Neutral pentatonic
nonMosStructures.note: Two neutral thirds framing the fifth.
